items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: I've teamed up with a very fine pianist... Graham Coyle. We've played, we had what we call the Polites Coyle Ragtimers, just as a name of a group

ctx.x: Now, you can, do you listen to the record of Perfect Rag or do you look at the sheet music of it or?
No, I do it off the record. I always have. From the record.

I got it from the old Jolly 1923 Genet I think, recording of Perfect Drag. I think that was it. I just played it over and over and over and over again until I got a melody out of it and got some idea of the chords. What I have done each year at the jazz conventions for quite a few years, I've teamed up with a very fine pianist, probably our best pianist in Australia, Graham Coyle.
